description: This file contains custom exception classes and helper methods used in the Orleans serialization framework, defining specific error conditions likely encountered during serialization/deserialization processes.

classes.name: SerializerException
classes.description: Base exception class for serializer errors, serializable and generating serializer attributes.

classes.name: FieldIdNotPresentException
classes.description: Thrown when a field ID is expected but missing in serialized data.

classes.name: SchemaTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Thrown when an invalid schema type is encountered.

classes.name: FieldTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Thrown when an invalid field type is encountered.

classes.name: FieldTypeMissingException
classes.description: Thrown when a required field type is missing during deserialization.

classes.name: ExtendedWireTypeInvalidException
classes.description: Thrown when an extended wire type is invalid.

classes.name: UnsupportedWireTypeException
classes.description: Thrown when a wire type is unsupported.

classes.name: ReferenceNotFoundException
classes.description: Thrown when a referenced value is not found, storing target reference details.

classes.name: UnknownReferencedTypeException
classes.description: Thrown when a referenced type is unknown, holding reference id.

classes.name: ReferenceFieldNotSupportedException
classes.description: Thrown when a reference to a value is used where not supported.

classes.name: UnknownWellKnownTypeException
classes.description: Thrown when a well-known type ID is unknown.

classes.name: IllegalTypeException
classes.description: Thrown when a type is explicitly disallowed for serialization.

classes.name: TypeMissingException
classes.description: Thrown when an expected type is missing during deserialization.

classes.name: RequiredFieldMissingException
classes.description: Thrown when a required field is absent.

classes.name: CodecNotFoundException
classes.description: Thrown when no serializer codec is found for a type.

classes.name: UnexpectedLengthPrefixValueException
classes.description: Thrown when a length prefix does not match expected value.

classes.name: ExceptionHelper
classes.description: Static class providing helper methods for throwing exceptions, such as ArgumentOutOfRange.

methods.name: ThrowArgumentOutOfRange
methods.description: A generic method that throws an ArgumentOutOfRangeException for the provided argument name.
